diagram_assessment.rationale: A diagram can orient the meridian, stem, moving point, and coordinate relabeling while making the inverse convention visible. The formulas and proof already specify these details, so absence alone is not a defect.
recommended_content: In the punctured disk Y^(j), show q_j, the fixed punctures, q_i, the transported stem h_(i,j) composed with tau_i, and the based meridian that follows the stem, traverses C_i clockwise, and returns along the reverse stem.
Show that only coordinate j moves in M_j(gamma_(i,j)^cw); for the relabeled view, show R(Q)=Q^rho with the moving coordinate placed last and state R^D_*(A_ij)=kappa^rho([gamma_(i,j)^cw]).

Include a sign note: the positive standard generator A_in maps to the clockwise fibre meridian, while the raw ordered slice of W_in has counterclockwise winding and the configuration identification inverts that slice.

Represent equality of braid classes through the proved maps and point-pushing comparison. Do not present the raw trajectory of W_ij as literally the one-coordinate motion; the source explicitly does not claim such an isotopy of the displayed trajectories.

convention_checks.based_meridian_orientation: gamma_(i,j)^cw follows the stated stem, traverses C_i clockwise once, then returns along the reverse stem
convention_checks.coordinate_motion: M_j moves only the j-th point and fixes every other labelled coordinate
convention_checks.terminal_fibre_inverse: For the counterclockwise fibre meridian lambda_r, Psi_n^conf([A_rm]) = (kappa_*[lambda_r])^{-1} = kappa_*[lambda_r^cw]
convention_checks.relabelling: R(x)_k = x_(rho^{-1}(k)); R sends Q to Q^rho with q_j last and maps the motion to the terminal-coordinate fibre class
convention_checks.standard_word: W_ij = sigma_(j-1)...sigma_(i+1) sigma_i^2 sigma_(i+1)^(-1)...sigma_(j-1)^(-1); the rightmost factor runs first
convention_checks.mapping_class_sign: Theta_n(A_in)=Push_n([gamma_(i,n)^cw]); positive A_in corresponds to the clockwise point push
convention_checks.raw_slice_sign: The raw ordered slice of W_in is counterclockwise; Psi_n^conf inverts the coordinate loop class
convention_checks.composition_order: h_(i,j)=H_(j-1) composed with ... composed with H_(i+1), with the rightmost map acting first

diagram_assessment.crossing_or_word_claims: The source fixes the algebraic word and stacking convention but gives no drawn crossing diagram for this item. A proposed drawing must not invent crossing signs or claim the raw word trajectory is the one-coordinate path.
diagram_assessment.mathematical_finding: No defect found in the clockwise meridian, inverse-endpoint convention, inverse configuration identification, relabeling direction, or rightmost-factor-first word convention.
